integrity: The result and verification have been reviewed for logical scope, correctness, and scientific relevance; finite experiments are not presented as exhaustive for unbounded parameters.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is confined to double brooms with length at least two and center degrees at least two; finite numerical tests are supportive, not an infinite proof. Related 2025 thesis full text was inaccessible, so independent historical-priority verification remains open.
title: Spectral sustainability and indispensable edges in subdivided double brooms
